rationale: Motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and injury to the policyholder fits the auto claim type definitively.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was rear-ended on Route 9 at 8:15 am yesterday by a vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; the car is totaled with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Other driver's information is documented in the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light by vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
